svg.title: A new label is a finite overlap-connected atom set containing at least one old forced label, with the old forced supports mutually disjoint. Its new support is the union of all atom supports, its inventory the union of the old forced inventories, and its coefficient the product of its atom factors, restricted to its exact inventory and original eligibility conditions. These labels form a countable set; it is infinite since each singleton old forced label is one. Choose an enumeration by N. This choice only names the labels and does not change their functions or bounds. Expand the old forced gas times exp P jlj using Q j(1 + (elj −1)). Absolute summability
